name: 1-hexanol
aliases: 1-hexyl alcohol, 1-hydroxyhexane, amylcarbinol, caproic alcohol, capronyl alcohol, caproyl alcohol, hexyl alcohol, n-hexan-1-ol
summary: 1-Hexanol (IUPAC name hexan-1-ol) is an organic alcohol with a six-carbon chain and a condensed structural formula of CH3(CH2)5OH. This colorless liquid is slightly soluble in water, but miscible with diethyl ether and ethanol. Two additional straight chain isomers of 1-hexanol, 2-hexanol and 3-hexanol, exist, both of which differing by the location of the hydroxyl group.
